props.name: 24 h durability test of electrode B at −0.2 V/RHE

evidence.quote: We therefore performed a chronoamperometric 24 h durability test of our most promising electrode B, which is shown in Figure 10.

After the initial current decrease, attributable to catalyst activation and a progressive decrease of the HER [53], the current density remains relatively constant and does not show a further decrease, indicating no significant catalyst degradation during this extended period.

The Faradaic efficiency for formate is nearly constant (6.7% after 2 h and 6.0% after 24 h). The decrease is more important for acetate (from 52.1% after 2 h to 38.4% after 24 h), indicating that the more complicated mechanism for the formation of C2 products is more prone to poisoning of catalytic sites, for example, by irreversible adsorption of CO.
